registry_metadata.title: DPDP Act 2023 & DPDP Rules 2025 Website Automation, AI-Agent, Session Replay & Dark-Pattern Signature Registry
registry_metadata.statutory_authority: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (No. 22 of 2023) & Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 846(E), notified 13 Nov 2025)

signatures.name: HubSpot Marketing & CRM Tracking
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: HubSpot CRM and marketing automation script (`_hsq` / `hubspotutk`) is present to associate page visits and form submissions with longitudinal contact profiles.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Gate `_hsq` initialization and collected-forms scraping behind affirmative Section 6 consent via `_hsq.push(['doNotTrack'])` until opt-in, and disclose CRM contact scoring in the Rule 3 notice.

signatures.name: Adobe Marketo Engage (Munchkin)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Adobe Marketo Munchkin tracking (`_mkto_trk`) is configured for B2B lead scoring and behavioral journey attribution.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Defer `Munchkin.init()` execution until the Data Principal grants affirmative marketing consent under Section 6(1) and document automated lead scoring in the Rule 13(2) register.

signatures.name: Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Salesforce Pardot (`pd.js` / `visitor_id`) telemetry is configured for prospect activity tracking and automated qualification.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Configure Pardot tracking code to respect consent state prior to setting `visitor_id*` cookies and list Salesforce Account Engagement in the Rule 3 itemized notice.

signatures.name: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Collect.js / Interaction Studio)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Personalization beacon (`_etmc` / `Evergage`) is present for real-time next-best-action personalization.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Initialize `SalesforceInteractions` with `consents: []` by default and invoke `updateConsents` only after explicit Section 6 opt-in.

signatures.name: Braze Customer Engagement SDK
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Braze Web SDK (`appboycdn.com`) is integrated for omnichannel lifecycle messaging, in-app prompts, and cohort segmentation.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Delay `braze.initialize()` and `braze.openSession()` until affirmative consent is recorded, and support `braze.wipeData()` upon consent withdrawal under Section 6(4).

signatures.name: MoEngage Customer Engagement & Analytics
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: MoEngage Web SDK (`cdn.moengage.com`) is active for behavioral event tracking, push notifications, and automated user journey orchestration.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Enable MoEngage SDK opt-out tracking mode by default (`Moengage.update_user_data_tracking(false)`) and activate only upon explicit Section 6 consent.

signatures.name: WebEngage Retention & Marketing Automation
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: WebEngage SDK (`webengage` / `we_luid`) is loaded for multi-channel user retention workflows and on-site notification targeting.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Conditionally load `webengage.init()` via Consent Management Platform (CMP) callbacks after affirmative user consent under Section 6(1).

signatures.name: CleverTap Omnichannel Retention Platform
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: CleverTap (`clevertap` / `WZRK_G`) is deployed for real-time behavioral segmentation, RFM scoring, and automated campaign triggers.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Set `clevertap.privacy.push({optOut: true})` by default on initial page load and toggle to `optOut: false` only after verifiable Section 6 consent.

signatures.name: Netcore Cloud (Smartech) Marketing Automation
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Netcore Smartech (`smartechclient.js`) is integrated for AI-driven product recommendations, web messages, and customer journey tracking.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Invoke `smartech('optOut', 1)` prior to consent and bind `smartech('optOut', 0)` to the CMP's affirmative marketing consent event.

signatures.name: Klaviyo E-Commerce Marketing Automation
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Klaviyo onsite tracking (`_learnq` / `__kla_id`) is configured for cart abandonment triggers and predictive customer lifetime value modeling.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Gate `klaviyo.js` loading behind Marketing consent in your CMP and ensure email/SMS capture forms include unbundled Section 6 consent checkboxes.

signatures.name: ActiveCampaign Site Tracking
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: ActiveCampaign site tracking (`vgo` / `trackcmp.net`) is present to link web browsing activity to CRM automation workflows.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Remove automatic `vgo('process', 'allowTracking')` on page load and call it exclusively after the Data Principal grants affirmative consent.

signatures.name: Intuit Mailchimp Connected Sites
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Mailchimp Connected Site script (`chimpstatic.com`) is loaded for newsletter pop-ups and campaign attribution.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Gate `mcjs-connected` scripts behind functional/marketing consent and include a clear Rule 3 purpose notice on subscription forms.

signatures.name: Zoho PageSense & Marketing Automation
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Zoho PageSense / MarketingHub script (`pagesense.io` / `ma.zoho`) is active for funnel analysis, heatmaps, and lead nurturing.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Configure Zoho PageSense privacy settings to require explicit visitor opt-in prior to setting `zc_cu` or `zps-tgr-dts` tracking cookies.

signatures.name: Freshworks Freshmarketer / Freshsales Suite
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Freshmarketer CRM & conversion optimization script (`cdn.freshmarketer.com`) is present for visitor journey tracking.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Defer `fw-cdn.com` marketing script injection via your CMP until affirmative consent is obtained under Section 6(1).

signatures.name: Customer.io Behavioral Messaging
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Customer.io (`_cio` / `track.customer.io`) is configured for event-triggered messaging and user lifecycle automation.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Withhold `_cio.identify()` and `track.js` initialization until the Data Principal provides affirmative Section 6 consent.

signatures.name: Omnisend E-Commerce Marketing Automation
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Omnisend (`omnisnippet1.com`) is loaded for shopper segmentation and automated cart recovery campaigns.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Bind `omnisend` snippet execution to the CMP marketing consent category and disclose automated cart reminders in the Rule 3 notice.

signatures.name: Drip E-Commerce CRM & Automation
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Drip CRM (`_dcq` / `tag.getdrip.com`) is active for behavioral tagging and automated email workflows.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Prevent `tag.getdrip.com` from setting `_drip_client_*` identifiers prior to explicit user consent under Section 6(1).

signatures.name: Google Tag Manager (GTM Container)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Google Tag Manager (`gtm.js` / `dataLayer`) orchestrates client-side tag firing and downstream third-party script execution.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Implement Google Consent Mode v2 with default `denied` state (`ad_storage`, `analytics_storage`, `ad_user_data`, `ad_personalization: 'denied'`) prior to loading `gtm.js`.

signatures.name: Twilio Segment Customer Data Platform (analytics.js)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Twilio Segment CDP (`cdn.segment.com/analytics.js` / `ajs_anonymous_id`) collects unified customer events and fans them out to downstream destinations.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Integrate `@segment/analytics-consent-tools` to block `analytics.load()` and destination routing until category-level Section 6 consent is granted.

signatures.name: RudderStack Customer Data Pipeline
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: RudderStack CDP (`rudderanalytics` / `rl_anonymous_id`) streams client-side behavioral telemetry to warehouse and marketing destinations.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Use RudderStack's Consent Management integration (`cookieConsentOptions`) to suppress `rl_anonymous_id` persistence and event delivery prior to Section 6 opt-in.

signatures.name: mParticle Customer Data Platform
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: mParticle Web SDK (`jssdkcdns.mparticle.com`) manages cross-device identity resolution (`identity.mparticle.com`) and audience forwarding.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Configure mParticle `ConsentState` APIs and forwarding rules so no third-party kit initializes before affirmative consent under Section 6(1).

signatures.name: Snowplow Behavioral Data Engine (sp.js)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Snowplow tracker (`_sp_id` / `_sp_ses`) captures granular event streams and user session telemetry.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Initialize Snowplow in `anonymousTracking: { withServerAnonymisation: true }` mode prior to consent, switching to persistent `_sp_id` cookies only after Section 6 opt-in.

signatures.name: Tealium iQ / AudienceStream CDP (utag.js)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Tealium Universal Tag (`utag.js`) and AudienceStream (`collect.tealiumiq.com`) manage tag orchestration and real-time visitor badge stitching.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Enable Tealium Consent Enforcement and Privacy Manager extensions to block non-essential tags and `collect.tealiumiq.com` calls until opt-in.

signatures.name: Adobe Experience Platform Launch / Web SDK (Alloy.js)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Adobe Experience Platform Launch (`assets.adobedtm.com` / `_satellite`) and Experience Cloud ID Service (`AMCV_`) coordinate cross-channel visitor identity.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Set Adobe Web SDK `defaultConsent: 'pending'` or `'out'` in `alloy('configure')` and call `setConsent` only after explicit Section 6 consent.

signatures.name: Microsoft Clarity Session Replay & Heatmaps
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Microsoft Clarity (`clarity.ms` / `_clck`) records DOM mutations, scroll heatmaps, and click/rage-click behavioral telemetry.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Invoke `window.clarity('consent', false)` by default, enforce strict DOM masking (`data-clarity-mask="true"`) on all personal data regions under Section 8(5), and activate only after Section 6 consent.

signatures.name: Hotjar (by Contentsquare) Session Recording & Surveys
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Hotjar (`static.hotjar.com` / `_hjSessionUser_*`) captures session replays, interaction heatmaps, and on-site feedback polls.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Delay `hotjar.com` script injection until explicit Analytics/Behavioral consent is granted, and apply `data-hj-suppress` attributes to all sensitive DOM elements.

signatures.name: FullStory Digital Experience Intelligence
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: FullStory (`edge.fullstory.com/s/fs.js`) performs high-fidelity DOM serialization, console/network logging, and session replay.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Initialize FullStory with `window['_fs_capture_on_startup'] = false`, invoke `FS('setConsent', true)` only after Section 6 opt-in, and enforce Private-by-Default `.fs-exclude` masking under Rule 6.

signatures.name: LogRocket Session Replay & Frontend Telemetry
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: LogRocket (`LogRocket` / `_lr_id_`) records DOM replay alongside Redux/state mutations and XHR/Fetch request payloads.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Gate `LogRocket.init()` behind explicit consent and configure `dom: { inputSanitizer: true, textSanitizer: true }` plus `network: { requestSanitizer }` to strip tokens and PII under Rule 6.

signatures.name: Smartlook (by Cisco) Qualitative Analytics & Replay
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Smartlook (`rec.smartlook.com/recorder.js`) captures continuous session recordings and interaction funnels.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Pause Smartlook recording by default (`smartlook('pause')`) until affirmative Section 6 consent is obtained and apply `data-sl="mask"` across all personal data fields.

signatures.name: PostHog Product Analytics, Autocapture & Session Replay
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: PostHog (`posthog` / `ph_phc_*`) is configured for DOM autocapture, feature flags, and session recording.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Initialize PostHog with `opt_out_capturing_by_default: true`, `persistence: 'memory'`, and `session_recording: { maskAllInputs: true, maskTextSelector: '*' }` until explicit Section 6 opt-in.

signatures.name: Mouseflow Session Replay & Form Analytics
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Mouseflow (`cdn.mouseflow.com` / `_mfq`) tracks mouse movement trajectories, friction scores, and form field drop-offs.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Set `window.mouseflowAutoStart = false` and invoke `mouseflow.start()` exclusively after affirmative consent under Section 6(1).

signatures.name: Crazy Egg Heatmaps, Scrollmaps & A/B Testing
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Crazy Egg (`script.crazyegg.com` / `CE2`) captures click heatmaps, confetti reports, and visitor snapshots.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Gate `script.crazyegg.com` execution via your CMP under Analytics/Behavioral consent and list Crazy Egg in the Rule 3 notice.

signatures.name: Contentsquare Digital Experience Analytics
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Contentsquare (`t.contentsquare.net/uxa/` / `_cs_id`) performs zone-based heatmapping, journey analysis, and session replay.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Push `_uxa.push(['setOption', 'isConsentRequired', true])` before tag initialization and trigger `hasGivenConsent` only after Section 6 opt-in.

signatures.name: Inspectlet Dynamic Heatmaps & Session Recording
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Inspectlet (`cdn.inspectlet.com` / `__insp`) records visitor screen sessions and input interactions.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Block `inspectlet.js` prior to affirmative Section 6 consent and add `inspectlet-sensitive` CSS classes to all inputs and personal data containers.

signatures.name: Lucky Orange Session Recordings & Dynamic Heatmaps
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Lucky Orange (`tools.luckyorange.com` / `_lo_uid`) captures live visitor views, session recordings, and conversion funnels.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Enable Lucky Orange privacy consent mode (`LO.privacy.optOut()`) by default and opt in only when explicit Section 6 consent is recorded.

signatures.name: Intercom Fin AI Agent & Messenger Widget
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Intercom Messenger / Fin AI Agent (`widget.intercom.io`) is embedded, establishing persistent device identifiers (`intercom-device-id-*`) and processing conversational transcripts.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Use a lightweight click-to-load launcher placeholder so `widget.intercom.io` and `intercom-device-id-*` cookies initialize only upon user interaction or consent, and display a Rule 3 AI/chat notice.

signatures.name: Salesloft Drift Conversational AI & B2B Chat
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Drift Conversational AI (`js.driftt.com` / `driftt_aid`) is active for automated lead qualification and IP-to-company enrichment.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Configure Drift GDPR/Consent settings (`drift.config({ enableCookieConsent: true })`) to prevent `driftt_aid` profiling before affirmative Section 6 consent.

signatures.name: Crisp Chat & MagicReply AI Chatbot
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Crisp Messaging & AI bot (`client.crisp.chat/l.js`) is loaded on the page with persistent session storage.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Set `window.CRISP_RUNTIME_CONFIG = { lock_maximized: false }` and defer `client.crisp.chat/l.js` until the user opens the support widget or consents.

signatures.name: Freshworks Freddy AI & Freshchat Messenger
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Freshchat / Freddy AI conversational widget (`wchat.freshchat.com`) is embedded for automated customer support and lead capture.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Present a concise Rule 3 purpose notice within the Freshchat pre-chat welcome card and evaluate Freddy AI intent models under Rule 13(2).

signatures.name: Zendesk Messaging & AI Answer Bot (zdassets.com)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Zendesk Web Widget (`static.zdassets.com` / `zE`) is integrated for automated AI triage and support ticketing.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Call `zE('webWidget', 'updateSettings', { cookies: false })` on initial page load and enable cookies only after user interaction or Section 6 consent.

signatures.name: Tidio Lyro AI Conversational Agent
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Tidio Chat & Lyro AI (`code.tidio.co`) is active for automated visitor engagement and LLM-powered customer Q&A.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Enable Tidio's pre-chat privacy consent prompt and document Lyro AI knowledge-base grounding and guardrails under Rule 13(2).

signatures.name: LiveChat & ChatBot.com Widget
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: LiveChat / ChatBot.com (`cdn.livechatinc.com` / `__lc_cid`) is loaded for visitor monitoring and automated conversational flows.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Defer `tracking.js` execution until user click or consent, and include a Rule 3 privacy notice link in the chat header.

signatures.name: Botpress Generative AI Webchat Agent
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Botpress LLM Webchat (`cdn.botpress.cloud/webchat/`) is deployed as an autonomous conversational AI agent.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Disclose LLM processing and third-party model sub-processors in the Rule 3 notice, redact PII in conversation logs under Rule 6, and assess prompt/hallucination risks under Rule 13(2).

signatures.name: Voiceflow AI Agent Chat Embed
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Voiceflow AI Agent (`cdn.voiceflow.com/widget`) is embedded to execute LLM-driven conversational workflows.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Include an explicit Rule 3 disclosure banner before initiating `general-runtime.voiceflow.com` sessions and review automated agent actions under Rule 13(2).

signatures.name: Ada.cx Automated AI Customer Service Agent
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Ada AI Customer Service Agent (`static.ada.support/embed2.js`) is integrated for automated ticket resolution.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Configure `adaSettings` with a transparent privacy notice and include Ada's generative AI decisioning in the organisation's Rule 13(2) algorithmic risk assessment.

signatures.name: Yellow.ai Dynamic Enterprise AI Agent
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Yellow.ai Conversational AI (`cdn.yellowmessenger.com` / `ymConfig`) is active for automated customer service and transactional workflows.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Ensure the Yellow.ai welcome flow presents an itemized Rule 3 notice (with multilingual option matching the 22 Eighth Schedule languages) before collecting personal data, and audit LLM guardrails under Rule 13(2).

signatures.name: Jio Haptik Conversational AI & WhatsApp Commerce Bot
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Jio Haptik Web SDK (`toolassets.haptikapi.com`) is embedded for conversational AI assistance and lead capture.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Configure `haptikInitSettings` to require user acknowledgment of the Rule 3 privacy notice prior to capturing phone numbers or personal identifiers.

signatures.name: Verloop.io Conversational AI Support Automation
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Verloop.io AI chat widget (`verloop.io/livechat`) is present for automated customer support triage.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Gate Verloop user profile binding (`setUserId` / `setUserParams`) behind explicit consent and document automated intent classification under Rule 13(2).

signatures.name: Gupshup Conversational Messaging & AI Bot
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Gupshup Conversational Bot (`gupshup.io`) is integrated for omnichannel web and messaging automation.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Provide a clear Section 5 / Rule 3 notice before initiating WhatsApp or SMS handoffs via Gupshup and log opt-in timestamps.

signatures.name: Wati.io / WhatsApp Business Floating Widget
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Wati / WhatsApp Business chat launcher (`clare.ai` / `wa.me`) initiates messaging sessions that share the user's phone number and metadata with WhatsApp/Meta.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Display a pre-click tooltip or modal informing the Data Principal that clicking opens WhatsApp and processes their phone number under the Rule 3 privacy notice.

signatures.name: OpenAI / Anthropic / Google Dialogflow CX Direct Web Embed
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: A direct Generative AI / LLM web agent (`df-messenger` / `chatbase.co` / `openai`) is embedded on the page to process free-text user prompts.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Conduct a formal Rule 13(2) algorithmic risk assessment on the embedded LLM, enforce PII redaction filters under Rule 6, and disclose cross-border model providers under Rule 15.

signatures.name: Meta Pixel (fbq) & Automatic Advanced Matching
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Meta Pixel (`fbevents.js` / `fbq` / `_fbp`) is present; when `signals/config/` is active, Automatic Advanced Matching may hash DOM form fields (email, phone, name) for cross-site ad attribution.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Execute `fbq('consent', 'revoke')` before `fbq('init')`, disable Automatic Advanced Matching in Meta Events Manager unless specifically consented under Section 6(1), and suppress entirely for known child sessions under Section 9(3).

signatures.name: Google Ads Conversion Tracking & DoubleClick Floodlight
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Google Ads / DoubleClick Floodlight (`googleadservices.com` / `doubleclick.net` / `_gcl_aw`) is configured for conversion attribution and remarketing.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Enforce Google Consent Mode v2 (`ad_storage: 'denied'`, `ad_user_data: 'denied'`, `ad_personalization: 'denied'`) by default and upgrade only after explicit Section 6 marketing consent.

signatures.name: LinkedIn Insight Tag (lintrk / snap.licdn.com)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: LinkedIn Insight Tag (`snap.licdn.com` / `lintrk` / `bcookie`) is active for B2B audience matching and demographic profiling.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Conditionally inject `insight.min.js` only after the Data Principal grants affirmative Advertising/Marketing consent in the CMP under Section 6(1).

signatures.name: TikTok Pixel & Advanced Matching (ttq)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: TikTok Pixel (`analytics.tiktok.com` / `ttq` / `_ttp`) is present for ad attribution and behavioral audience building.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Invoke `ttq.holdConsent()` prior to `ttq.load()`, verify cross-border transfer admissibility under Section 16 / Rule 15, and grant consent via `ttq.grantConsent()` only upon opt-in.

signatures.name: X (Twitter) Universal Website Tag (twq)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: X / Twitter Universal Website Tag (`static.ads-twitter.com/uwt.js` / `twq`) is loaded for campaign conversion tracking and retargeting.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Gate `uwt.js` execution behind affirmative Marketing consent in the CMP and disclose X Corp. as an advertising third party in the Rule 3 notice.

signatures.name: Snap Pixel (sc-static.net / snaptr)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Snap Pixel (`sc-static.net/scevent.min.js` / `snaptr`) is deployed for cross-device ad conversion tracking.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Delay `snaptr('init')` until affirmative marketing consent is granted under Section 6(1) and disable tracking for minors under Section 9(3).

signatures.name: Criteo OneTag Dynamic Retargeting
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Criteo OneTag (`criteo_q` / `cto_bundle`) is active for cross-site behavioral retargeting and bid optimization.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Block `ld.js` and `cto_bundle` storage prior to explicit Section 6 advertising consent and include Criteo in the Rule 3 third-party disclosure.

signatures.name: Taboola Pixel & Content Recommendation Graph (_tfa)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Taboola Pixel (`cdn.taboola.com/libtrc/` / `_tfa`) is loaded for native ad retargeting and behavioral interest graphing.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Suppress `_tfa.push({notify: 'event', name: 'page_view'})` until explicit Section 6 marketing consent is captured.

signatures.name: Outbrain Amplify Pixel (obApi)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Outbrain Amplify Pixel (`amplify.outbrain.com/cp/obtp.js` / `obApi`) tracks reader interest profiles across publisher networks.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Gate `obtp.js` behind affirmative Section 6 consent in your CMP and provide an easy opt-out mechanism under Section 6(4).

signatures.name: OneTrust Privacy & Consent Management Platform
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: OneTrust CMP (`otSDKStub.js` / `OptanonConsent`) is deployed to manage cookie categories and user consent preferences.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Verify that the India/DPDPA geolocation rule in OneTrust enforces strict opt-in (prior blocking of non-essential categories), provides equal-prominence 'Reject All', and links to the 22 Eighth Schedule language notices under Rule 3.

signatures.name: Usercentrics Cookiebot CMP
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Cookiebot CMP (`consent.cookiebot.com/uc.js`) is integrated for automated script blocking and consent banner display.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Ensure `data-blockingmode="auto"` is enabled on the Cookiebot script tag and that the banner presents unbundled category toggles and an accessible withdrawal widget under Section 6(4).

signatures.name: CookieYes Consent Management Platform
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: CookieYes CMP (`cdn-cookieyes.com` / `cookieyes-consent`) is active to capture and log visitor consent choices.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Configure CookieYes for the DPDP Act 2023 template with strict prior blocking of Analytics/Advertisement categories and a persistent revisit-consent button.

signatures.name: Osano Data Privacy Platform
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Osano CMP (`cmp.osano.com`) is loaded to govern script execution and consent records.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Set Osano compliance mode to Strict Opt-In for Indian visitors so no non-essential scripts execute prior to affirmative consent under Section 6(1).

signatures.name: TrustArc Cookie Consent Manager
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: TrustArc Consent Manager (`consent.trustarc.com`) is present on the website.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Ensure `notice_behavior` defaults to `expressed,eu` (strict opt-in) for all sessions subject to the DPDP Act 2023 rather than implied/opt-out mode.

signatures.name: Klaro! Open-Source Consent Manager
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Klaro! consent manager (`klaro.js` / `klaroConfig`) is integrated for client-side script gating via `data-type="application/javascript"`.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Verify that `klaroConfig.default` is `false` for all non-essential services and that `declineAll: true` is displayed on the initial banner layer.

signatures.name: Didomi Global Privacy & Consent Platform
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Didomi CMP (`sdk.privacy-center.org` / `didomi_token`) is configured to manage consent notices and vendor preferences.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Map Didomi vendor purposes to an itemized Rule 3 notice and ensure equal visual prominence between 'Agree' and 'Disagree' actions.

signatures.name: Sourcepoint Dialogue CMP
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Sourcepoint CMP (`cdn.privacy-mgmt.com` / `_sp_`) is present for privacy messaging and consent orchestration.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Configure the Sourcepoint campaign workflow to enforce strict opt-in prior to firing analytics or advertising tags under Section 6(1).

signatures.name: Usercentrics Enterprise CMP
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Usercentrics CMP (`app.usercentrics.eu` / `UC_UI`) is deployed for granular service-level consent management.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Enable the Usercentrics Smart Data Protector or GTM Consent Mode integration so third-party embeds remain blocked until affirmative Section 6 consent.

signatures.name: First-Party Custom DPDP Act Consent Banner
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: A custom first-party consent banner (`dpdp_consent` / `cookie-banner`) is implemented on the website.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Verify that the custom banner blocks non-essential scripts prior to interaction, provides an itemized Rule 3 notice with 22-language support, includes an equal-prominence 'Reject All' button, and exposes a persistent footer link to withdraw consent under Section 6(4).

signatures.name: Pre-Ticked Marketing or Consent Checkbox (Bundled/Default Opt-In)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: One or more form or banner checkboxes associated with consent, terms, or marketing communications appear pre-selected (`checked`) by default in the DOM.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Remove the `checked` / `defaultChecked` attribute from all consent, marketing, and newsletter checkboxes so that Section 6(1) consent is signified by a clear, affirmative action of the Data Principal.

signatures.name: Asymmetric Accept vs. Reject Choice Architecture (Missing Reject All)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: The consent notice displays a primary 'Accept' / 'Agree' action without an equally prominent first-layer 'Reject All' / 'Decline Non-Essential' option, or requires multiple clicks to decline.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Add a first-layer 'Reject Non-Essential' button with identical button sizing, contrast ratio, and click-depth as 'Accept All' to ensure consent is free and withdrawal is as easy as giving consent under Section 6(1) and 6(4).

signatures.name: Early Form Field Capture (Pre-Submit Keystroke / Blur Listeners)
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Event listeners (`blur`, `change`, `input`, or collected-forms scripts) are attached to email/phone inputs capable of transmitting partial form entries before the user clicks 'Submit'.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Transmit personal data from web forms strictly on explicit `submit` events after the Data Principal has reviewed the Rule 3 notice and clicked the submission action.

signatures.name: Automatic Web Push Notification Permission Prompt on Page Load
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Web Push Notification scripts (`Notification.requestPermission()` / `OneSignal` / `iZooto`) are configured to prompt for browser push tokens immediately on page load without prior context.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Replace immediate browser push prompts with a two-step opt-in (a contextual Rule 3 soft-prompt explaining what notifications will be sent and how to unsubscribe) before calling `Notification.requestPermission()`.

signatures.name: Canvas, WebGL, or AudioContext Device Fingerprinting
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Stateless device fingerprinting signals (`FingerprintJS` / Canvas `toDataURL` / `WEBGL_debug_renderer_info` / `OfflineAudioContext`) are present to derive a persistent hardware/browser identifier.
signatures.constructive_remediation: If device fingerprinting is used solely for fraud prevention/security under Section 8(5), document the narrow security purpose and retention period under Rule 8(3); if used for analytics or marketing attribution, gate behind explicit Section 6 consent.

signatures.name: Service Worker Background Sync & Navigator sendBeacon Exfiltration
signatures.reputation_safe_observation: Background telemetry primitives (`navigator.serviceWorker.register`, `navigator.sendBeacon`, or `fetch(..., { keepalive: true })`) are active for page-unload or background event transmission.
signatures.constructive_remediation: Ensure `sendBeacon` and Service Worker background sync handlers inspect the current CMP consent state before dispatching telemetry, and unregister tracking Service Workers when consent is withdrawn under Section 6(4).
